issues.reason: The Name-string half stands — the title rule keeps only a courtesy title in the string ('Dr Okoro') and the name is 'exactly its capitalized run of words', so the post-comma appositive tag 'D-Waco' makes the `Name` fact false — but the 'content otherwise dropped' half falls, since expanding 'D-Waco' to party and district is world knowledge with no licensed carrier and omission in gap territory is not a defect.

Passing a bill is a collective act of the addressed body, and *Coordination & plurals* / *Quantifiers* keep a collective predicate group-only ('Distributing there would assert that every crew member separately repaired the pipe'), so the per-member `(PartOf $x sk_colleagues_1)` range with Skolem events `(sk_pass $x)` / `(sk_watch $x)` is an unlicensed individuation — though, as an implication's antecedent, it asserts nothing of any colleague.

Passing a bill neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes it, nor reworks an informational artifact's content; the instruction set's nearest precedent is `(Theme sk_approve_1 sk_plan_1)` for 'the committee approved the plan' and its explicit tiebreaker is 'when the test is unclear, default to `Theme`'.

gaps_confirmed: direct quotation as a speech verb's complement — the attitude section covers finite that-clauses only — including a quote split around the reporting clause and reassembled
second-person 'you' — no rule for addressee reference
an `Implication` nested as a sealed `Theme` term — sealing is defined for a proposition or an `(And …)` bundle, not for a rule
abbreviated party-and-district appositive on a legislator's name ('D-Waco')
new_gaps: a conditional inside a seal: the indicative-conditional rule gives a top-level `Implication` statement, but the seal admits only terms, so the rule's own truth value has nowhere to live and the sealed conditional inherits the attitude atom's TV
an honorific abbreviation ('Rep.') in the `Name` string — the title rule names kinship and courtesy titles, not professional/office abbreviations, though the same treatment plainly extends
repair_summary: Trimmed the `Name` string to the name proper, `(Name john_mabry_jr "Rep. John Mabry Jr.")`; replaced the per-colleague quantified rule in the sealed `Theme` with a ground implication over the addressed group — antecedent `(And (Member sk_pass_1 pass) (Agent sk_pass_1 sk_colleagues_1) (Theme sk_pass_1 sk_bill_1))`, consequent `(And (Member sk_watch_1 watch) (Agent sk_watch_1 big_brother) (Theme sk_watch_1 sk_colleagues_1) (Future sk_watch_1) (Ongoing sk_watch_1))`; changed `Patient` to `Theme` on the bill.
notes: The reporting frame (Experiencer teller, Recipient addressee, content sealed under `Theme`), the Future+Ongoing stacking, the `Theme` on 'watching you', and the projection of the demonstrative 'this bill' out of the seal are all correct and untouched.
